notes.title: 2.3.4 - for streamers
notes.notes:
Hi,
For streamers, now you can display a chat overlay, in order to stay connected to your viewers.
How to ? In the folder /AncederRift_Data/StreamingAssets/chatoverlay.txt, paste the URL of your chat. Then run the game and in OPTIONS, activate "Chat Overlay". Then write something in your chat. More instructions in the chatoverlay.txt file.

At this point you can do 2 things WHILE PLAYING : 
1 - you can freeze/unFreeze the game without making a pause : press the LB button (xbox Gamepad like). This is to let you time to read what you want.
2 - you can show/hide the chat with the X button (xbox gamepad like).

Other things added :
- Possibility to change the screen resolution and full screen option
- Fixed : the DPAD was doing Down+Left instead of Left only.
- Fixed : Camera looking upward in the SAS when not in VR.

If you want to stream, choose a non-full screen resolution, and if you use a mirroring (oculus), you can use the lowest resolution as it won't be streamed. Or simply unplug your VR headset if you wan't to play in non-VR (easier to watch for viewers, harder to play for the player).

notes.title: 2.3.x update with a lot of things...
notes.notes:
Anceder has been updated on steam as it was on Oculus store this year. So this is a major update on Steam.
There are more bonus, don't forget to look at the left/right on the first explanations screen.
There are more sounds. All in high quality. Pump up the volume to enjoy.
There are 2 more languages supported : Spanish & Chinese.
A lot of CPU & GPU optimisations have been done, so the game should run even more smoothly on middle-end PC's.

Anceder has been tested with a Rift (by the way, you can also find Anceder on Oculus Go). I don't have an HTC Vive but It should work the same way as I use native's Unity rigging.

Contact :

If you find bugs or have ideas and want a quick answer, please write to cedric@anceder.com. As a solo indie developer, I don't have enough time to read comments everywhere ;). And Steam especially is a gaz factory hard to handle :'(.

You can follow @ancedergame on twitter to be notified if there are new updates.

notes.title: A bit less hard with a megabomb.
notes.notes:
Good news fellows,[b] Update 1.6.5 is here[/b].

The enemy bulelts will be more obvious, more flashy. And If you like Fury mode, [b]you'll have +1 megabomb[/b]. So If you play in Hard Fury mode, you've got 5 megabombs. Have fun !
